zh: 单词只按空白切分，每个单词能否计数完全由它自身决定，与其他单词无关；所以只需逐个检查切出来的 token。
一个 token 有效需要同时满足四个条件：长度至少 3、每个字符都是 ASCII 字母或数字、至少一个元音（a/e/i/o/u，大小写都算）、至少一个辅音（不是元音的字母；数字既不是元音也不是辅音）。
按空白切出所有 token；对每个 token 扫描一遍字符，遇到非 ASCII 字母数字的字符立即判无效，同时记录是否出现过元音、是否出现过辅音字母；长度≥3 且两个标记都为真时计数加一，最后输出计数。
en: Words are split only on whitespace, and whether a word counts depends only on the word itself, so you just need to check each token on its own.

A token is valid only when all four conditions hold: length at least 3, every character an ASCII letter or digit, at least one vowel (a/e/i/o/u in either case), and at least one consonant (a letter that is not a vowel; digits are neither).

Split the input on whitespace. For each token, scan its characters once: any character that is not an ASCII letter or digit makes it invalid, and along the way record whether a vowel and a consonant letter have appeared. Count the token when its length is at least 3 and both flags are set, then print the count.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Scan the tokens split on whitespace, recording for each whether it is valid, whether it contains a vowel, and whether it contains a consonant.

## Correctness

A token is counted only when it satisfies the character domain, the length, and both letter conditions at the same time; this is equivalent, item by item, to the original definition, and each token is processed exactly once.

## Complexity

Time O(|s|), space O(1) (not counting the split result).
